# Output Contract

Personal reports: core outcomes, verified completions, done-pending-verification, progress, blockers, next priorities, and coverage.

Project reports: objectives, milestones, workstreams, validation/release evidence, risks/decisions, next plan, and coverage.

Portfolio reports: cross-project outcomes, project workstreams, shared risks, decisions, priorities, and coverage.

For `brief`, omit commit lists and implementation chronology. For `full`, include bounded item/evidence identifiers and hashes, never raw source content.
